title: HomePilot — 60 s English ad (app screens, voice)

scenes.ovoz: Furnace. Roof. Water heater. Who's keeping track?
Receipts get lost. Warranties expire. Service dates get forgotten.
Meet HomePilot, your home maintenance companion.
See your whole home at a glance: your systems, your home health, and what's coming up next.
Keep every system in one place. HVAC, roof, plumbing and more.
Get a simple maintenance plan, and check off tasks as you go.
Save receipts and warranties, and see what your home really costs.
Ask the assistant what's due next. It answers from your own home records.
HomePilot. A little care goes a long way.
